milestones.description: Uses inventory_has for flower_pot because breaking a potted_poppy block drops a flower_pot and a poppy as separate items — the block name 'potted_poppy' never appears as an inventory item. The player starts with no flower_pot in inventory, and there is no other source of flower_pot in this scene, so having one uniquely proves the potted poppy was mined. Preferred over count_in_box_at_most (block removal check) because inventory_has is coordinate-independent and more robust for mine tasks.
